text: The UEBA system flagged this week for ZCS0012 due to unusual volume of attachment data sent to external recipients. Specifically, [F001] shows that Zenaida Carol Snow sent 54.57 MB of email attachments, which is beyond her typical range (23.37-45.10 MB) and significantly more than same-role peers this week (15.75 MB). Additionally, [F002] reveals that she had 61 external recipients, exceeding her typical number (39) and the average for same-role peers this week (44).
